_doc: Recurring design-intent → Velt-component mappings (the GENERAL shape, not design-specific CSS). The planner reads these as priors so it doesn't re-derive the same mapping every run. The exact cssDecls/values for a specific design remain project-scoped (target repo .velt-customize/memory.json), never here.

patterns.intent: comments sidebar surface (docked panel: header + scrollable list + composer)
patterns.note: The single wireframe registry root for a sidebar surface. Host mount: VeltCommentsSidebar with embedMode + pageMode + shadowDom={false}.

patterns.intent: page-mode comment composer (collapsed pill -> expanded with attach/mention/send)
patterns.note: Composer states: default collapsed pill, active (focused, toolbar), active-typing (send enabled). Attach + mention icons appear on focus/has-content.

patterns.intent: comment card / thread (avatar + author + body + reactions + reply)
patterns.note: KNOWN-HARD (see component-difficulty). Resists wireframe replacement; build minimal, cap fixes.
Header ~48px, filter trigger ~28px. Supply the filter dropdown items explicitly.
